verdict.rationale: The firm documents its own fully self-service Contract Generator, available as a tailored DIY contract generator inside the GDHQ online platform, which lets clients self-serve real agreements such as offer letters and invention assignment agreements at no cost. Its web-based D&O Questionnaire Portal also replaces paper/PDF questionnaires with online completion. The evidence clearly shows generation of real documents rather than static templates, but it is thin on how the interactive assembly works and is limited to client-exclusive access. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the interactive question-driven assembly workflow and document coverage, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates

citations.quote: Hundreds of our clients depend on our fully self-service Contract Generator platform
It also includes your tailored DIY contract generator and our SMART Request intake forms
clients self-serve complex agreements such as employment offer letters, proprietary information agreements, and invention assignment agreements quickly and efficiently — at no cost to the client
